requirements_summary: Need hybrid pipeline: thousand-scale qps sustained across daily batch updates; index size target 120M doc segments (~6-8B tokens). Embeddings: prefer 1024-2048 dim open embeddings (edge-runner) or customer-provided vectors. Reranking: lightweight bert/ instruction-tuned 1-6B model in VPC for last-mile reordering. K/V cache and prefix caching required per clinician session. Must support immutable per-query audit logs shipped to customer SIEM and KMS-backed key management for model keys. Data residency: US-only. Retention: configurable per-namespace down to 30d purge window.
technical_notes: Evaluation metrics: retrieval recall@10 for case notes, rerank MRR uplift, latency p50/p95, cost/query estimate. Suggested infra: Dedicated GPU pool with autoscaling + warm KV cache nodes, block-level encryption, HNSW with dynamic sharding. Interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching + quantization (8-bit) to reduce GPU footprint. Request: sample kernel perf numbers for Llama-7B quantized reranker in VPC (p50 token latency) and cost model for 1M queries/month.
